scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@zorkaliser/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@zorkaliser/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@zorkaliser/shared && npm run build --workspace=@zorkaliser/api && npm run build --workspace=@zorkaliser/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@zorkaliser/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@zorkaliser/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@zorkaliser/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@zorkaliser/api && npm run test --workspace=@zorkaliser/web
